map.音频频率分析器借助麦克风实时检测音高、频率与音名，将声音可视化为频谱，适合练耳、: The audio frequency analyzer uses the microphone to detect pitch, frequency and note names in real time and visualizes sound as a spectrum, suited to ear training, tuning and acoustics experiments.
map.用麦克风实时测音高/频率，辅助练耳与调音: Measure pitch/frequency live with a microphone to aid ear training and tuning
map.把人声/乐器声可视化为频谱，看基频与泛音分布: Visualize voice or instrument sound as a spectrum showing the fundamental and overtone distribution
map.声学实验里抓暂态峰值频率做记录: Catch transient peak frequencies for records in acoustics experiments
map.：对信号做 FFT 取幅值最大频点 f，再按 C0=16.3516 Hz 算 M: : take the FFT of the signal, pick the frequency bin f with the largest magnitude, then compute the MIDI number n = 12 x log2(f/C0) with C0 = 16.3516 Hz; rounding gives the nearest note name and the fraction times 100 gives cents deviation, e.g. 440 Hz -> A4 (0 deviation).
map.：唱 A4 时基频约 440 Hz，其上方 880、1320 Hz 等整数倍为泛: : singing A4 has a fundamental near 440 Hz, with integer multiples such as 880 and 1320 Hz above it as overtones; the spectrum shows frequency on the horizontal axis and amplitude on the vertical, with the peak series forming the harmonic structure.
map.分析器怎么找到音高？: How does the analyzer find pitch?
map.常用自相关或 FFT 峰值法：FFT 找能量最大频点近似基频，自相关更抗谐波干扰: Common methods use autocorrelation or the FFT peak: FFT finds the highest-energy frequency bin as the approximate fundamental, while autocorrelation resists harmonic interference better; the result is then converted to a note name and cents.
map.噪声大、多音同时响或基频弱（如鼓）会偏；安静环境、单音、靠近麦克风最稳。: Noise, several notes sounding together, or a weak fundamental (such as drums) cause deviation; a quiet room, single notes and a close microphone work best.
